intro.heading: Avin Gaur
lines: I spend a lot of time thinking about businesses, trying out new ideas, and getting involved in things that interest me.
Currently finishing my time at IIT Delhi. This website is a little bit of what I've been up to.

entries.title: Wootz Work
entries.description: Leveraging data driven insights to drive GTM strategy across EMEA

entries.title: Kepler Cannon
entries.description: Worked on strategy, profitability analysis, and analytics for a US retail bank.

entries.title: Campus Fund
entries.description: Evaluated early-stage startups and worked on investment research and commercial due diligence.

entries.title: Glexica
entries.description: Worked on product positioning, website strategy, and user experience at an AI SaaS startup.

entries.title: UC Berkeley, Haas School of Business
entries.description: Worked on research examining household energy usage and consumer behaviour.

entries.title: MountTech Growth Fund
entries.description: Researched startups and investment opportunities in deep technology, defence, and aerospace.

campus.heading: My Journey at Campus
campus.intro: IIT Delhi has been more than classes and exams. It's where I've had the chance to explore different interests, meet interesting people, and try things outside my comfort zone.

entries.title: Business & Consulting Club
paragraphs: A lot of my time at IIT Delhi has gone into the Business & Consulting Club. It's where I first got to work with real startups, lead projects, and put together initiatives for the rest of campus.
Mostly, it taught me how much you can learn by just showing up and figuring things out alongside good people.

entries.title: Placement Cell
paragraphs: Being part of the placement cell meant a lot of coordinating with teams and talking to companies through the recruitment process. It's a very different view of placements than the one you get as a candidate.

entries.title: Beyond Academics
paragraphs: Events, late-night conversations, hostel life, and the people who made it all memorable. A lot of what I'll remember from campus happened outside a classroom.

thoughts.heading: Thoughts
thoughts.subheading: Occasional notes on things I find interesting.

beyond.heading: Beyond the Resume
beyond.description: There's a lot more to me than the things I put on a resume. This is a small space for everything else — places, people, interests, random projects, and things that make life interesting.

connect.heading: Let's Connect
connect.text: Always happy to talk about an interesting idea, collaborate on something, or just have a conversation.

description: Avin Gaur — final-year student at IIT Delhi, interested in startups, strategy, technology, and a lot of things in between.
